decisions.decision: Alternative site layout (parking on east or west side with connecting road or drive) not pursued further; not enough benefit.
decisions.quote: it was agreed by all present that there did not appear to be enough of a benefit to pursue this option further.

decisions.decision: Eliminate a portion of the existing high school driveway loop in Phase 1 to accommodate a full-size field along MA Ave (approved, no motion recorded); one-way high school traffic and possible relocation of HC parking.
decisions.quote: the option to eliminate a portion of the existing high school driveway loop in phase 1 in order to accommodate a full size field along ma ave was discussed and approved.

decisions.decision: New soccer field to be irrigated and sodded.
decisions.quote: the new soccer field will be irrigated and sodded.

decisions.decision: 4' black vinyl coated chain link fence offset from Mass Ave sidewalk approved (approved, no motion recorded).
decisions.quote: 4' black vinyl coated chain link fence offset from mass ave sidewalk (10' +/- to allow snowbank) was approved to stop ground balls.

decisions.decision: Tall netting to stop all balls along Mass Ave will not be included.
decisions.quote: it was agreed that any tall netting to stop all balls would be undesirable along mass ave and will not be included.

decisions.decision: Bleacher location on east side with 600 seats approved (approved, no motion recorded).
decisions.quote: the location as currently shown with 600 seats was approved based on proximity to game day parking and the memorial entrance gate.

decisions.decision: No lighting at tennis or basketball courts.
decisions.quote: it was agreed that there will be no lighting at tennis or basketball.

decisions.decision: Bus drop-off in front of the school to plan for 10 buses.
decisions.quote: this amount of busses was confirmed as the correct quantity to plan for.

decisions.decision: Single auto pick-up/drop-off loop retained; no separate middle school loop.
decisions.quote: it was decided that a single loop is the best approach as students of different ages are picked up and dropped off in the same car

decisions.decision: Keep the current design layout for the new access road around the concession building, despite utility concerns.
decisions.quote: it was decided by those present to keep the current design layout.

decisions.decision: Pedestrian connection between new school and Turkey Hill School to remain in design, routed as directly as possible without compromising the flat lawn or the archery/sledding hill.
decisions.quote: it was confirmed that such a connection is desirable and should remain in the design

decisions.decision: Synthetic turf option to be considered at end of project only if contingency remains; base contract is natural grass.
decisions.quote: a synthetic turf field option would be desirable and this might be an option at the end of the project if there is remaining contingency available

decisions.decision: Small field north of gym to serve as a ceremonies lawn or tent site; no additional area needed.
decisions.quote: it was agreed that the new small field to the north of the gym could function as a lawn for céremonies or a tent if that was ever required, no additional area is necessary.

decisions.decision: No exterior maintenance building in project scope; no slab for a future location.
decisions.quote: it was agreed that no exterior maintenance building will be included as part of the scope of the project so no slab will be provided for a future location.

decisions.decision: Memorial gate to be preserved close to the fields.
decisions.quote: memorial gate will be preserved close to fields.

decisions.decision: Signage at Mass Ave and Oak Ave driveway entrances, with lighting at identity sign locations; wayfinding and traffic signage in contract scope.
decisions.quote: signage for the new school will be located at mass ave and oak ave driveway entrances.

decisions.decision: Entrance roadway to have 12' wide speed tables.
decisions.quote: the entrance roadway will have speed tables that are 12' wide to slow traffic entering and exiting the site.

decisions.decision: School to notify parents and public of the traffic pattern change for September 2014.
decisions.quote: school will notify parents and public of change in traffic pattern for september 2014.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A new scoreboard is out of project scope; the Owner will seek to furnish it from donations. No dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: a new scoreboard is not in scope and the owner will seek to furnish this from donations.
